verdict.rationale: Box ships its own AI agents (Box AI API, agent configurator), so asking whether they can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence only documents Box acting as an MCP server at mcp.box.com that other agents connect to. That is the server role and earns no credit for this client-side story. Nothing shows Box AI connecting to or using tools from third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
